summary: At the Waste Leadership Summit, Waste Connections announced plans to spend $100 million on AI through 2027. GFL Environmental, Casella, WM and Republic Services also previewed their new AI strategies.

title: Amid growing vape waste woes, industry calls for multilayered solutions
summary: Experts from the EPA, Reworld, Arcwood and state agencies at the Healthcare Waste Institute unpacked complicated regulatory and disposal hurdles, calling for more recycling policies to address end-of-life outlets.
